reason: I pick dinner from whatever cooking video I see that day, so I don't plan around what's in my fridge. Scanning receipts every shop sounds like extra work I wouldn't keep up. The free version is fine to look at, but paying for Plus isn't something I'd do.
objection: I already cook from Instagram and TikTok videos on the day, so I don't see why I'd log my groceries into another app. I'd scan receipts for two weeks and then forget it.
would_change_my_mind: If my husband or the helper were already using the shared list and it saved us from buying the same things twice, I'd stick with the free version. Paying would still need a clear reason.
